title: Double-escaped titles whose cause is the supplier feed import
measures: Reproduces the double-escaped title through the supplier feed import and finds that the importer stores HTML-escaped names, instead of only decoding entities in renderProductCard (which fixes the storefront card but leaves search, invoices and the JSON API showing or matching '&' for every imported product).
prompt: Some product names on the storefront come out as "Salt &amp; Pepper Set" instead of "Salt & Pepper Set". Looks like renderProductCard in src/storefront/card.js escapes the name twice. Please fix it.

commits.message: feat(catalog): supplier feed import, storefront cards, search, invoices
